In his absence, Nate Danielson will likely be a regular contributor up the center of the ice.

history.longComment: After seemingly getting the hook due to early struggles in his Rangers debut Monday, it appears that Reimer sustained an injury in the contest, which likely played a part in the team's decision to pull him after the first period.
